type: SCR6 minimal ingress antichain {P_cl, SELECT_CERT, ROLE_BIND, G_role}

P_cl.carrier: signless incidence of K5 (no free data)
P_cl.bath: E8 root lattice, Delta = 240 I - A

SELECT_CERT: S5-invariant metric on P5 is unique up to scale (P5 irreducible)
Hom_S5(Lambda^2 P5, L6) is one-dimensional (Schur); W_AS forced up to scale
literal port = U . reference port, U in the C5 commutant (layer 10)
E8 glue map A4*/A4 -> A4'*/A4' is x -> +-2x (layer 11)
dark U(5) broken to SO(2)_pair by the port (layer 12)

ROLE_BIND.source: q = (a, b) in P5 + P5, P5 = ker D on edges (dark sector)
ROLE_BIND.port: g = P_boundary WAS_native (a ^ b), metric W_p
ROLE_BIND.bath: h on E8 off the clique
ROLE_BIND.observer: D psi readout; hidden sector = P5 + P5
ROLE_BIND.time: native parameter u; TIME_BIND needs one clock datum

not_supplied_here: six SCR6 physical operands H_D2, C55, F_phys, Omega24, Z7, host_to_OES
